title: Multi-agent skills: reply alternatives
description: Select a named $defs entry. Semantic cross-field, byte-length and grapheme constraints are additionally specified in the normative documents.

id.description: The engine also enforces at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema length alone counts code points.

name.description: Immutable versioned map name declared by the binding.

carrier.description: Only envelope mappings are allowed. Omitted fields resolve to body; non-body source tokens must be declared by the binding. Payload, actor and clock are not mappable.

name.description: Immutable versioned map name declared by the binding.

carrier_identity.description: Full resolved carrier map pinned in binding-owned session identity. Restore must verify exact profile, name and all four source mappings.

band_proposal_body.description: Band carrier/1 proposal body. Session may be omitted; if present it must equal the authorized path:id after normalization.

http_compact_view.description: Standalone current role view without the immutable definition; all facts, legal rules, duties and extension fields retain their engine schemas.

http_compact_projection.description: Standalone POST /v1/view wire response. The opaque preflight checkpoint/hash are unchanged; GET /v1/definition supplies the role definition once.

http_definition.description: Standalone authenticated GET /v1/definition response; the client must also verify actor/session/identity against its pinned authority. Not a Band capability claim.

participant_attributes.description: The engine also checks this object against its declared participant type and limits canonical encoded UTF-8 bytes.
